decision: the owner, 2026-10-09: "fast travel by waystone stays limited so travel remains part of the game"; waystones at the MAIN areas too, "like ferry ports or research centers, not like the Articuno research camp, but main areas".
rung: existing functionality (CLAUDE.md principle 6): the Waystones mod's own block, set by `setblock` exactly as tools/place_town.py sets a town's. No config key, mod or script is added.
unlock: discovery: the first visit activates it. Waystones activates a waystone on a right-click (docs/world-building/NAVIGATION.md section 2); nothing here is flag-driven, so no hub waystone is in data/progression.json, none is forgotten by tools/progression_pack.py, and none is a blackout checkpoint (tools/blackout_pack.py lists the town waystones only).
how_travel_stays_limited: every town waystone is badge-pre-activated or earned by a visit; a hub is earned by a visit; the config charges no XP and no cooldown (base-pack/cobbleverse/config/waystones-common.toml enableCosts false, enableCooldowns false), so the limit is that a waystone is unknown until its place has been walked, sailed or ridden to once, and that no craftable waystone, sharestone, portstone, warp plate or warp item exists (data/player_waystone.json).
positions: each in its own place's data file under `waystone` {at: [x, z], facing}: tools/coldwater_station.py refuses any build column within its authored_clearance of an x/z another data file authors, and skips its own file. `hubs[].path` is where to read it; tests/test_hub_waystones.py checks the three agree with this registry.
